_comment: Ranks and badges (spec: UI rules, Ranks and badges). Ranks follow real Mission Control jobs; you rise by the stars you have earned across the levels. Badges are earned by deeds in flight, in the album, the Daily and Rescue History. Names and how-to-earn words are UI copy (sdWords RANK_WORDS, BADGE_WORDS); the job descriptions are Sourced and marked to verify.
